name: iconclass-retriever-bge-large-ft
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. A finetune of BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 (335M, hidden 1024, 24 layers, 1024 output dims, 512 max positions) on the iconclass art-historical iconography dataset, MultipleNegativesRankingLoss, 3 epochs. Same config.json and tensor set as the base. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-06-05. THIN EVIDENCE, and the record says so: exactly one row is recorded, cosine_ndcg@10 0.2707 from the card's InformationRetrievalEvaluator block, and the base value 0.0719 is not in that block — it is the 'Epoch -1' row of the same card's training-log table, which is the pre-training evaluation of the same checkpoint on the same dataset. That makes it a same-card, same-dataset, same-metric comparison, but the comparison lives across two tables rather than inside one. The released checkpoint's own eval (0.2707) matches the logged epoch-3.0 value. The training log peaks higher mid-run (0.2975 at epoch 0.75) and the released model is the 3-epoch one, so the card is not shipping its best logged checkpoint. Highly domain-specific: no MTEB or BEIR numbers.

benchmarks.name: iconclass cosine_ndcg@10
benchmarks.config: Card evaluation section InformationRetrievalEvaluator on the iconclass dataset prints 0.2707; base value 0.0719 is the Epoch -1 row of the same card's training log.
